target: acceptance 1 — no hook fires when a diff exists, so the review stage must emit explicitly. This is the stated mechanical proxy: the instruction must be present, and it must name the actual subcommand.
cmd: f="$PLUGIN_ROOT/skills/review/SKILL.md"; n=$(grep -c "observe.sh diff-size" "$f"); sec=$(grep -A4 "observe.sh diff-size" "$f" | tr "\n" " " | tr -s " "); base=$(printf "%s" "$sec" | grep -ci "base\|branch point"); printf '{"calls":%s,"namesBase":%s}' "$n" "$base"
